evaluation.scope_selection: All supported supplied objects, independent of candidate locations, frames and correctness.
limitations: Whole supplied map retrieval is not visibility-conditioned perception accuracy.
No output is not a factual unchanged prediction; no true-negative accuracy is reported.
Unsupported drivable-area state comparisons are excluded.
Constructed-train development scene, not an independent test.
Type counts overlap; candidate diagnostics are separate from confirmed positives.

m2_diagnostics.interpretation: Duplicate physical boundaries can create identity ambiguity. A flag on every observation is a global risk notice, not an object-specific curb diagnosis.

verification_scope: Actual frozen-M2 M3/M4 numerical rerun; M8 exports used only after freezing predictions. Browser checks against local HTTP build in Chromium/SwiftShader; live Pages delivery not verified.
